# itsmatias

> Portfolio of Matias Zanan, a remote design engineer who designs and builds production websites end to end: design tokens, motion and the production code behind them. He also sells ready-to-deploy Next.js website templates.

## Who it is for

- Founders and small businesses that need a website or web app designed and built by one person, without agency handoffs.
- Developers and businesses that want a production-ready Next.js template they deploy to their own Vercel in one click.

## Work

- [E-commerce & Admin](https://ecommerce.itsmatias.com): a storefront and its admin panel with catalog, real-time stock, orders and email notifications.
- [mySocials](https://links.itsmatias.com): link-in-bio pages with a custom URL, themes and click analytics.
- [Money Tracker](https://money.itsmatias.com): expenses across currencies for nomads and expats; every expense keeps the exchange rate of its day.
- [Nomad Events](https://events.itsmatias.com): a community events platform with registration, QR check-in, galleries and an admin panel.

## Templates and pricing

- [Templates](https://itsmatias.com/templates): one-time purchase, deployed to the buyer's own Vercel account.
- E-commerce & Admin Panel: USD 990 one-time.
- Landing Page: USD 49.99 one-time.
- [Terms & License](https://itsmatias.com/terms)

## Stack

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Postgres, Turso, Vercel.
